comments.body: Thanks for the contribution. `_TZ3210_eejm8dcr / TS0505B` has now been adopted into the current RGB LED strip controller after re-checking the original interview against the modernized driver. Tracking: #1469, draft integration PR: #1470.

Thanks for the contribution. `_TZ3000_kfu8zapd / TS0044` has now been adopted into the current 4-gang wall remote driver after re-checking the original device interview against the modernized driver. Tracking: #1469, draft integration PR: #1470.

Thanks for this contribution and the physical verification. `Zbeacon / TS011F` has now been selectively adopted into the current metering smartplug driver on `modernize-2026-issues`. Validation is green. Tracking: #1469, draft integration PR: #1470.

Thanks for this contribution and the Homey Pro verification. `HOBEIAN / ZG-305Z` has now been selectively adopted into the current 2-gang switch driver on `modernize-2026-issues`. We are keeping the modernized code line as the source rather than merging the older SDK3-based PR wholesale. Tracking: #1469, draft integration PR: #1470.

Thanks for this contribution and the hardware context. `Wing / TS0203` has now been selectively adopted into the current door/window sensor driver on `modernize-2026-issues`. The generated manifest/device index are synchronized and validation is green. Tracking: #1469, draft integration PR: #1470.

Thanks for this contribution. `_TZ3210_ddigca5n / TS011F` has now been selectively adopted into the current `smartplug` driver on `modernize-2026-issues`. We are preserving the verified change without merging the older SDK3-based branch wholesale. Tracking: #1469, draft integration PR: #1470.

Thanks for this contribution. The three verified Ekaza identities have now been selectively adopted onto `modernize-2026-issues` as part of the 2026 backlog cleanup. We are not merging older SDK3-based PRs wholesale, but the relevant manifest changes are preserved in the new code line. Tracking: #1469, draft integration PR: #1470.

Closing this as superseded by the current modernized implementation. `_TZE200_3towulqd / TS0601` is already supported by `motion_sensor_2`, including motion, luminance and battery handling. The old PR is therefore no longer the implementation we want to merge. Tracking: #1469.

Closing this as superseded by the current modernized implementation. `_TZE200_3towulqd / TS0601` is already supported by `motion_sensor_2`, including the relevant endpoint/cluster handling. Tracking: #1469.

Closing this as superseded by the current modernized FingerBot implementation. The current driver already supports `_TZ3210_j4pdtz9v` and now has substantially more complete Tuya datapoint, mode, battery, time, Flow and settings handling than the implementation proposed here. Merging this PR today would regress that functionality. Tracking: #1469.

Closing this as superseded by the current modernized code. `_TZ3000_ww6drja5` is already present in the current `smartplug` manifest, so there is no remaining change to merge from this PR. Tracking: #1469.

The physically verified `_TZ3000_k6fvknrr / TS011F` double-power-point identity has now been selectively adopted onto `modernize-2026-issues` and passes the current validation suite. I am leaving this PR open because the separate `curtain_motor` Open/Stop/Close behavior has not been adopted; that part needs its own review so we do not couple an identity-only fix to a behavioral change. Tracking: #1469, draft integration PR: #1470.

Leaving this open for now. `_TZ3000_an5rjiwd / TS0041` is not being adopted blindly into `smart_button_switch`: available device evidence shows a multi-endpoint TS0041 variant, while the current driver is a simple one-endpoint button profile. We need to resolve the endpoint/behavior match before deciding the correct driver. Tracking: #1469.

This mixed PR has now been split during the 2026 backlog cleanup. The verified/compatible pieces were selectively adopted onto `modernize-2026-issues`: `_TZ3210_cwamkvua / TS0202` → existing `pir_sensor_2`, `_TZ3000_a37eix1s / TS0004` → existing 4-channel driver, and `_TZ3000_empogkya / TS0003` → existing `switch_3_gang` (so a duplicate `zemismart_6gang` driver is not needed). The `_TZE200_kb5noeto` addition was not adopted into `radar_sensor`: its actual endpoint profile does not match that EF00-based driver. The `_TZE204_r0jdjrvi`/curtain behavior is also being kept separate for protocol review. Current validation is green. Tracking: #1469, draft integration PR: #1470.

Keeping this PR open for dedicated curtain-family review rather than absorbing it as a simple fingerprint addition. The Quoya `_TZE200_gubdgai2` family is physically verified, but its endpoint profile and position direction differ from assumptions in the current shared `curtain_motor` driver. The global inversion/limit changes therefore need to be reconciled without changing behavior for the many existing curtain identities. Tracking: #1469.

This mixed PR has been split during the 2026 cleanup. `_TZ3000_996rpfy6 / TS0203` was independently verified as a standard IAS contact sensor and has been adopted into the current `doorwindowsensor` on `modernize-2026-issues`; validation is green. The other changes are not safe to merge as-is: `_TZE200_pay2byax / TS0601` would broaden the product-ID matrix of a large shared driver and also has luminance behavior that driver does not implement; `_TZ3000_mrpevh8p / TS0041` supports single/double/hold while the current legacy button parser only distinguishes one/two clicks; and moving `_TZE200_vvmbj46n` between temperature/humidity drivers needs datapoint/battery verification. These should be handled as separate focused work. Tracking: #1469, draft integration PR: #1470.

Closing this PR because its current GitHub diff no longer contains the two drivers described in the PR body. The only remaining changed files are `.homeycompose/app.json` and the proposed `measure_fan_speed` capability, so merging it would not actually add either `_TZE204_lawxy9e2` or `_TZE204_nklqjk62` support. The garage-door request remains represented by #812 (and related request #721); fan/light support can be revisited as a separate complete driver contribution. Tracking: #1469.

2026 backlog triage: this PR has been split rather than merged wholesale. The GIRIER `_TZ3000_c8zfad4a / TS0203` contact sensor is supported by a full Zigbee interview (#1125) and has been adopted onto `modernize-2026-issues`. The Benexmart `_TZ3210_bfwvfyx1 / TS0505B` light remains tracked in #1091. Its endpoint/cluster shape looks close to a standard RGB+CCT light, but independent Zigbee reports document inconsistent/non-working color handling for this exact fingerprint, so it needs device-specific verification before we route it through the existing `rgb_spot_GU10` driver. Closing this old mixed PR; the unresolved light request remains open.

2026 backlog triage: the full interview confirms this is a standard IAS contact sensor profile compatible with the current `doorwindowsensor` driver. `_TZ3000_c8zfad4a / TS0203` has been adopted onto `modernize-2026-issues` and is covered by draft PR #1470.

2026 backlog triage: keeping this request open rather than blindly carrying over the old PR #1137. The interview exposes the expected On/Off, Level Control and Color Control clusters, but this exact `_TZ3210_bfwvfyx1 / TS0505B` fingerprint has independent reports of incomplete/inconsistent RGB and color-temperature behaviour in other Zigbee stacks. Before assigning it to the existing `rgb_spot_GU10` driver we should verify the actual Homey behavior on hardware, especially white↔color mode switching and the usable color-temperature range.

2026 triage completed for this historical PR. The fingerprint is a real TS0041 one-button remote candidate, but the old PR is insufficient because available evidence shows a multi-endpoint hardware variant and our current `smart_button_switch` runtime assumes a specific cluster-6 frame behavior. The unresolved work is now preserved in canonical issue #1471 with evidence and acceptance criteria. Closing this PR without merging it.

2026 triage complete. The physically verified `_TZ3000_k6fvknrr / TS011F` double-socket identity has already been selectively adopted into `modernize-2026-issues`. The separate curtain Open/Stop/Close work is valid protocol work, but belongs in the shared curtain-family review rather than this mixed PR. It is now preserved with evidence and acceptance criteria in #1472. Closing this historical mixed PR without losing the unresolved curtain work.

2026 triage complete. The Quoya work is not being discarded, but the PR changes shared `curtain_motor` behavior globally and therefore should not be merged wholesale. Device request #1405 remains open, and the shared protocol/profile work (DP1 state, position direction, reverse semantics and DP16 limits) is now tracked in #1472. Closing this historical implementation PR while retaining the verified evidence.

2026 maintenance note: this request is still considered unresolved in **this** repository. The earlier recommendation to use another Tuya app/fork is useful external evidence, but it is not being treated as a resolution here. PR #1406 contains physical-test evidence; the shared curtain-family behavior needed to integrate it without regressing existing devices is now tracked in #1472. Keeping this device request open until the Quoya profile is actually implemented here.

2026 triage complete. This PR identified a real TS110E protocol difference and the physical `_TZ3210_ngqk6jia` test is valuable, but moving an existing fingerprint to a new driver and registering a separate cluster implementation for Level Control ID `0x0008` is not the migration-safe way to land it. The verified behavior, external protocol evidence and a Homey-compatible implementation plan are now preserved in #1473. Closing this historical PR without discarding the fix.

2026 triage: the substantive fixes from PR #1121 are already present in the current `modernize-2026` implementation: IAS motion uses `onZoneStatusChangeNotification`, illuminance listens to `attr.measuredValue`, the Homey capability is `measure_luminance`, and `_TZE200_3towulqd / TS0601` is matched by `motion_sensor_2`. The current driver also configures reporting for IAS, battery and illuminance. Closing as superseded by the modernized codebase.

2026 maintenance pass: this `_TZE200_3towulqd / TS0601` case is now covered by the current `motion_sensor_2` implementation on `modernize-2026`. The driver matches the fingerprint and contains the corrected IAS Zone notification and illuminance `measuredValue` handling from the physically tested historical fix in PR #1121. Closing this historical request/bug as implemented in the modernized codebase.

2026 maintenance pass: this `_TZE200_3towulqd / TS0601` case is now covered by the current `motion_sensor_2` implementation on `modernize-2026`. The driver matches the fingerprint and contains the corrected IAS Zone notification and illuminance `measuredValue` handling from the physically tested historical fix in PR #1121. Closing this historical request/bug as implemented in the modernized codebase.

2026 triage complete. This PR contains useful evidence for `_TZE200_locansqn`, especially the missing Tuya response path and humidity scaling, but its time-sync payload conflicts with the 8-byte UTC/local behavior already used in the modernized code and current Zigbee2MQTT. The valid work is now preserved in #1474, with #1119 retained as the physical device case. Closing the historical PR without treating the external fork as resolution.

2026 maintenance pass: this remains the canonical physical `_TZE200_locansqn / TS0601` LCD sensor case. The fingerprint is already present in `lcdtemphumidsensor_3`, but review of historical PR #1346 found credible remaining issues in Tuya response handling and humidity scaling. Those implementation details are now tracked in #1474. The earlier recommendations to use another app/fork are not considered a resolution for this repository.

2026 historical-backlog note: this closed `_TZE200_locansqn / TS0601` request is not being used as evidence that the device was fully solved. The current canonical device case is #1119 and the remaining implementation work is tracked in #1474.

2026 historical-backlog note: this closed `_TZE200_locansqn / TS0601` request is not being used as evidence that the device was fully solved. The current canonical device case is #1119 and the remaining implementation work is tracked in #1474.

2026 triage complete. The SQ510A request is valid, but this PR duplicates our existing IAS water-sensor runtime and uses the ambiguous `eWeLink / SNZB-03` fingerprint that is also associated with the SONOFF motion sensor. The device evidence and a safe reuse/disambiguation plan are now preserved in #1475. Closing this historical implementation PR rather than adding another duplicate driver.

2026 triage complete. This PR combines two different THS317 families but its manifest only supports `_TZE200_iq4ygaai / TS0201`. The native `OWON / THS317-ET` device uses a standard Zigbee temperature profile and must not be assumed equivalent. The useful work is preserved in #1476, with #379 and #1007 retained as separate physical cases. Closing this historical mixed implementation PR rather than merging it wholesale.

2026 maintenance pass: keeping this as the canonical physical case for the native `OWON / THS317-ET` profile. Historical PR #1230 did not actually include this fingerprint. The split implementation work is now tracked in #1476.

2026 maintenance pass: keeping this as the canonical physical case for the Tuya-firmware probe `_TZE200_iq4ygaai / TS0201`. Historical PR #1230 contains relevant code but conflated this device with native OWON THS317-ET. The split implementation work is now tracked in #1476.

2026 triage: this is a duplicate physical request for the native `OWON / THS317-ET` already covered by #379. The implementation/profile split is tracked in #1476. Closing this duplicate without treating the device family as fully implemented.

2026 triage complete. This PR contains valuable original device work, but the shared-file formatter churn and unverified configuration writes should not be merged wholesale. The exact DP map, reusable Homey concepts, unit/scaling questions and the message-rate risk are now preserved in #1477. #1050 remains the physical device case. Closing this historical PR without discarding the implementation evidence.

2026 maintenance pass: this request remains open. Historical PR #1017 contains substantial support code, but external evidence shows that the read-only DPs and writable configuration DPs need separate verification, and this device has also been reported as unusually chatty. The focused implementation/verification work is now tracked in #1477. The earlier suggestion to use another app/fork is not considered resolution for this repository.

2026 triage complete. This PR contains valuable physical-device work, but it is explicitly incomplete (mode writes time out) and uses a low-level/raw implementation where current cluster-level handling should be evaluated first. The verified endpoint/action model and remaining work are preserved in #1478; #1024 remains the physical device case. Closing this historical v0.1 PR rather than merging it as-is.

2026 maintenance pass: keeping this request open. Historical PR #1106 contains substantial support code and current Zigbee2MQTT independently confirms the three relay endpoints and six button-action mapping for `_TZ3002_vaq2bfcu / TS0726`. The safe Homey implementation, including the still-unverified switch/scene mode writes, is now tracked in #1478.

2026 triage complete and selectively adopted. The physically verified `_TZE204_gkfbdvyx / TS0601` fingerprint plus its alternate DP layout (illuminance DP103, fading time DP105, no detection-delay write) are now on `modernize-2026-issues` in commits `7a6a248` + `9c44aa6`. CI run 84 passes tests, Homey publish validation, generated-manifest check and whitespace. The PR's global removal of cluster/binding 258 was deliberately not adopted because it would change the manifest contract for all existing `radar_sensor` identities. Closing the historical PR as superseded by the surgical implementation.

2026 triage complete. This PR duplicates the existing `wall_thermostat` driver for identities already supported there, and its DP16 ×10 scaling conflicts with established BHT-002 family mappings. The remaining work (profile/scaling audit plus `_TZE204_wc2w9t1s` verification) is preserved in #1479. Closing this implementation PR without changing installed-device driver identity.

2026 maintenance pass: `_TZE204_aoclfnxz / TS0601` is already matched by the current `wall_thermostat` manifest, so this is no longer just a missing-fingerprint request. The remaining BHT-family setpoint/local-temperature scaling and profile verification is now tracked in #1479. Keeping this historical physical-device request as evidence until behavior is verified.

2026 triage complete. The `_TZE284_gyzlwu5q` need is retained, but this implementation has an actual battery switch fall-through bug, references an undeclared `alarm_tamper` capability, listens only to one Tuya event path, and lacks sufficient independent DP verification. The proposed DP map and acceptance criteria are preserved in #1480. The fact that another app/fork supports the identity is useful evidence, not resolution for this repository. Closing the historical PR without merging it.

2026 triage complete. The physically verified MTG075 `_TZE204_mtoaryre / TS0601` support has been cleanly reimplemented on `modernize-2026-issues` instead of merging this 982-file wrong-base PR. Relevant commits: `07600b3` (focused driver), `e293670` (repository safety rules), `0293e2b` (publish assets), `594de0b` (Composer-correct generated manifest). CI run 90 is fully green: tests, Homey publish validation, generated-manifest check and whitespace. Closing this original PR as superseded.

2026 triage complete. The hardware-verified `_TZE200_3ylew7b4 / TS0601` Dooya RJ11 profile has been selectively reimplemented on `modernize-2026-issues` in `ba5f70d`, with Composer synchronization finalized in `594de0b`. CI run 90 is fully green. The unverified `_TZE200_f91miyhj` (#578) and `_TZE200_ol5jlkkr` (#1293) fingerprints were deliberately not carried over and remain separate verification cases. Closing this historical PR as superseded by the safer implementation.

2026 historical-backlog review: reopening this request. It was previously closed with 'Added', but `_TZ3000_o4mkahkc / TS0202` is not present in the current `modernize-2026` manifest. The interview confirms a standard IAS motion + Power Configuration profile, but current external evidence also shows hardware revisions with the same fingerprint behaving differently. The reported battery hardware is also 2×AAA, while the existing `motion_sensor` driver is modeled as CR2450. We should therefore verify the current hardware/profile before adding it rather than absorb the broad historical PR #1162.

2026 triage complete. This PR mixes the valid `_TZ3000_o4mkahkc / TS0202` request with broad changes to the shared motion driver and an unrelated `_TZE200_y8jijhba` mmWave driver. The original device request #1139 had been closed as 'Added' even though the fingerprint is not present in the modernized app, so #1139 has been reopened with current evidence and verification requirements. Closing this mixed historical PR without merging it.

2026 maintenance pass: keeping this request open. `_TZE204_bjzrowv2 / TS0601` has a valid Homey interview, and the older `_TZE200_bjzrowv2` suffix is already used by `curtain_motor`, but that similarity is not enough to prove identical Tuya datapoint semantics. Given the known variation across TS0601 curtain families, we need at least an Open/Stop/Close + position report capture or physical Homey test before routing this fingerprint into the existing driver. Historical PR #1194/#1195 are being closed rather than treating an identity-only change as verified support.

2026 triage: valid device request remains in #1186, but the PR only adds the fingerprint and does not establish that `_TZE204_bjzrowv2` shares the existing curtain motor datapoint/position semantics. Closing without merge pending behavior verification.

2026 triage: this PR edits generated `app.json` only. Homey Composer source-of-truth is the driver manifest; the underlying device request remains open in #1186. Closing as generated-file-only duplicate of #1194.

2026 triage complete. The two identities named in this PR are already represented in the modernized app: `_TZ3000_fa9mlvja / TS0041` via `smart_button_switch`, and `_TZ3000_rcuyhwe3 / TS0203` via `smart_door_window_sensor`. The PR also contains unrelated motion-sensor fixes already superseded by current code plus a separate `_TZE200_y8jijhba` mmWave driver. The open behavior bug for `_TZ3000_fa9mlvja` remains #747 and is not considered solved merely because the fingerprint pairs. Closing this mixed historical PR as superseded/split.

2026 triage complete. The physical interview is valuable, but this cannot safely be a fingerprint-only addition to current `motion_sensor_2`: the device has IAS + battery + illuminance but no Tuya cluster 61184, while the current driver declares and accesses `clusters.tuya` unconditionally. The valid device work is now preserved in #1481. The PR's old `Fixes #989, #944` references are also stale/incorrect for the current issue contents. Closing this historical PR without merging it.

2026 triage complete. `_TZE200_t1blo2bj / TS0601` has been selectively adopted into the existing NEO siren driver in `ed5e08b`. Current Zigbee2MQTT groups `_TZE200_t1blo2bj` and `_TZE204_t1blo2bj` as the same NAS-AB02B2 profile. The same commit also corrects the siren volume UI/Flow labels to the established DP5 mapping `0=Low, 1=Medium, 2=High`; unrelated changes from the historical PR were not carried over. CI run 91 passes tests, Homey publish validation, generated-manifest verification and whitespace. Closing as implemented.

2026 maintenance pass: `_TZE200_t1blo2bj / TS0601` is now implemented in the existing `siren` driver on `modernize-2026-issues` via commit `ed5e08b`. External NEO/Zigbee2MQTT evidence confirms it shares the NAS-AB02B2 profile with the already supported `_TZE204_t1blo2bj`. CI run 91 is fully green. Closing this device request as implemented.

2026 triage complete. This is not a safe fingerprint-only addition to the current `radar_sensor`. The Homey interview for `_TZE204_dapwryy7 / TS0601` lacks cluster 258, and more importantly current ZHA support documents a materially different Tuya DP layout: DP1 occupancy, DP101 target distance, DP102 illuminance, DP103 hold delay, DP107/108 max/min range, etc. Our existing `radar_sensor` uses a different default map (e.g. DP101 detection delay, DP102 fading time, DP104 illuminance, DP9 target distance). The valid device request remains open in #1146 with this profile evidence. Closing this historical manifest-only PR without merging it.

2026 maintenance note: keeping this as the canonical `_TZE204_dapwryy7 / TS0601` case. Historical PR #1218 is being closed because this device is not compatible with the current `radar_sensor` DP profile. Current ZHA evidence maps DP1=presence, DP101=target distance, DP102=illuminance, DP103=hold delay, DP104=LED, DP107/108=max/min detection range, with additional breath/small-motion ranges. This needs its own radar profile (or explicit per-manufacturer DP map), not a bare fingerprint.

2026 backlog consolidation: this is the same `_TZE204_dapwryy7 / TS0601` device profile now tracked canonically in #1146. The old fingerprint-only PR #1218 has been rejected because the datapoint layout differs from the current radar driver. Closing this duplicate while keeping #1146 open.

2026 triage complete. `_TZ3000_gjrubzje / TS0001` should not be added to the plain `switch_1_gang` driver: the physical interview in #1377 exposes Metering (0x0702) and Electrical Measurement (0x0B04), and the user explicitly needs W/kWh/V/A. The current `switch_1_gang_metering` runtime is a much closer fit, but its manifest also declares endpoint 2 while this device exposes only endpoint 1 (+ Green Power 242), so we should not redirect it blindly. Keeping #1377 open for an exact metering profile and closing this non-metering PR.

2026 maintenance note: this remains unresolved and is now explicitly treated as a metering-profile request. Do not route `_TZ3000_gjrubzje / TS0001` through `switch_1_gang`, because that would discard the device's Metering and Electrical Measurement capabilities. Reuse of `switch_1_gang_metering` should only happen after its endpoint-2 assumption is reconciled with this device's endpoint-1-only interview.

2026 triage complete. The physical HOBEIAN `ZG-227Z` interview in #1281 is a standard Zigbee temperature/humidity/battery profile (Basic + Power Configuration + Temperature Measurement + Relative Humidity) and does **not** expose Tuya cluster 0xEF00. The historical PR's runtime rewrite was therefore not adopted. Instead, an exact `HOBEIAN / ZG-227Z` driver was added on `modernize-2026-issues` in `1afcb43`, with 2×AAA metadata added in `872cdd3` and Composer ordering finalized in `2b67ce8`. It reuses the existing standard `temphumidsensor2` runtime. CI run 95 is fully green. Closing this historical PR as superseded by the focused implementation.

2026 maintenance pass: exact `HOBEIAN / ZG-227Z` support is now implemented on `modernize-2026-issues` using the standard Zigbee temperature/humidity/battery profile from this interview. Commits: `1afcb43`, `872cdd3`, `2b67ce8`. CI run 95 passes tests, Homey publish validation, generated-manifest verification and whitespace. Closing as implemented. Note that other products sold as ZG-227Z with different Zigbee fingerprints remain separate profiles and are not implied to be supported by this closure.

2026 triage complete. `_TZ3000_mh9px7cq / TS0044` has been selectively added to `handheld_remote_4_buttons` in commit `3b54153`. The physical interviews match the existing 4-endpoint On/Off action profile. CI run 95 is fully green. Closing this historical manifest-only PR as implemented.

2026 maintenance pass: `_TZ3000_mh9px7cq / TS0044` has been selectively added to `handheld_remote_4_buttons` in commit `3b54153`. The physical interviews match the existing 4-endpoint On/Off action profile. CI run 95 is fully green. Closing this device request as implemented.

2026 maintenance pass: `_TZ3000_mh9px7cq / TS0044` has been selectively added to `handheld_remote_4_buttons` in commit `3b54153`. The physical interviews match the existing 4-endpoint On/Off action profile. CI run 95 is fully green. Closing this device request as implemented.

2026 triage complete. `_TZ3000_wpueorev / TS0001` has been selectively added to `valvecontroller` in commit `3b54153`. The physical interview matches the driver's standard On/Off valve contract; additional Tuya/private clusters are not required by the runtime. CI run 95 is fully green. Closing this historical manifest-only PR as implemented.

2026 maintenance pass: `_TZ3000_wpueorev / TS0001` has been selectively added to `valvecontroller` in commit `3b54153`. The physical interview matches the driver's standard On/Off valve contract; additional Tuya/private clusters are not required by the runtime. CI run 95 is fully green. Closing this device request as implemented.

2026 triage complete. `_TZ3000_zgyzgdua / TS0044` has been selectively added to `wall_remote_4_gang_3` in commit `3b54153`. The physical interview matches the existing four-endpoint remote/action contract. CI run 95 is fully green. Closing this historical manifest-only PR as implemented.

2026 maintenance pass: `_TZ3000_zgyzgdua / TS0044` has been selectively added to `wall_remote_4_gang_3` in commit `3b54153`. The physical interview matches the existing four-endpoint remote/action contract. CI run 95 is fully green. Closing this device request as implemented.

2026 maintenance pass: keeping this as the canonical `_TZE200_2aaelwxk / TS0225` ZG-205Z/W case. Historical PR #774 contains substantial device-specific DP work, but its branch is 61 files wide and the implementation has several defects we should not carry over wholesale (including a `61148` binding typo, binding cluster 258 although the physical interview does not expose it, and a large/small Flow-condition registration mix-up). Current ZHA independently confirms the useful core profile: DP1 occupancy, DP2 large-motion sensitivity, DP4 large-motion distance, DP101 motion state, DP102 timeout, DP104/105 medium-motion distance/sensitivity, DP106 illuminance, DP107 LED and DP108/109 small-motion distance/sensitivity. Use that verified subset as the baseline for a clean 2026 implementation; treat the extra old PR datapoints as unverified until hardware evidence supports them.

2026 triage complete. This 61-file historical branch is not mergeable as-is, but the `_TZE200_2aaelwxk / TS0225` research is preserved in canonical device issue #1133. Current ZHA independently confirms the core TS0225 datapoint profile, while the PR implementation also contains concrete issues (e.g. `61148` binding typo, an unsupported/extra 258 binding relative to the interview, and Flow condition wiring mistakes). Closing this old PR so future work starts from a focused current implementation rather than the branch history.

2026 historical-backlog note: this closed `_TZE200_2aaelwxk / TS0225` request is consolidated under canonical #1133. Closed status here should not be read as proof that TS0225 support is already implemented; #1133 remains open with the verified current DP profile and historical PR #774 evidence.

2026 historical-backlog note: this closed `_TZE200_2aaelwxk / TS0225` request is consolidated under canonical #1133. Closed status here should not be read as proof that TS0225 support is already implemented; #1133 remains open with the verified current DP profile and historical PR #774 evidence.

2026 historical-backlog note: this closed `_TZE200_2aaelwxk / TS0225` request is consolidated under canonical #1133. Closed status here should not be read as proof that TS0225 support is already implemented; #1133 remains open with the verified current DP profile and historical PR #774 evidence.

2026 triage complete. This old PR contains useful `_TZE200_y8jijhba / TS0601` device work, but it mixes unrelated changes and predates current evidence that this exact HOBEIAN fingerprint is a presence+light profile and should not automatically expose temperature/humidity.

The valid Homey implementation work and current acceptance criteria are now preserved in #1482. Closing this historical PR without treating support in another fork as resolution for this repository.

2026 triage complete. The device identity is valid and external integrations classify `_TZE200_mgxy2d9f / TS0601` as a motion+battery sensor, but this historical runtime makes unverified assumptions about DP polarity, DP4 raw decoding, DP5 tamper and hourly Tuya polling.

The useful device work is preserved in #1483 with explicit acceptance criteria. Closing this historical PR without merging its polling/parser assumptions.

Additional historical evidence from PR #1292: this second `_TZE200_y8jijhba / TS0601` implementation uses standard Illuminance Measurement and Power Configuration for lux/battery, plus Tuya DP1 for presence. It proposes DP2 sensitivity, DP3 minimum range, DP4 maximum range and DP102 fading time, but the source itself marks several of those mappings as 'not sure' / 'might be correct'. 2026 follow-up after your new comment: I reviewed the current `gpmachado/com.gpm.moes` implementation and confirmed the repository is MIT licensed.

This is now a materially better implementation reference than historical PR #1204. The current driver is based on hardware sniffing and separates the three logical gangs on one physical Tuya endpoint, with confirmed per-gang DP maps:
- Gang 1: DP1 on/off, DP2 level, DP3 min, DP5 max
- Gang 2: DP7 on/off, DP8 level, DP9 min, DP11 max
- Gang 3: DP15 on/off, DP16 level, DP17 min, DP19 max
- Global: DP14 power-on behavior, DP21 backlight

It also addresses report dispatch to the correct Homey subdevice, min/max synchronization and write handling much more cleanly than the old PR.

I am therefore treating #1204 as historical evidence only. For this repo the preferred path is to port the device-specific, physically verified behavior from the current MIT driver onto our existing 2026 Tuya base layer, rather than importing/replacing our whole Tuya stack.

## Protocol mapping verified externally

Current zigbee-herdsman-converters uses a hybrid model:

- IAS Zone `zoneStatus bit 0` → occupancy/motion
- IAS Zone `zoneStatus bit 2` → tamper
- Tuya DP 107 → temperature ÷ 10 °C
- Tuya DP 108 → humidity %
- standard Illuminance Measurement → lux
- standard Power Configuration → primary battery %
- Tuya DP 110 → second battery %
- IAS attribute 19 → sensitivity (0/1/2 = low/medium/high)
- IAS manufacturer attribute 0xF001/61441 → keep time
- additional Tuya DPs 102/104/105/106/109/111/112 cover reporting/calibration/PIR/LED/reporting-enable settings

Importantly, this confirms that `zoneType=contactSwitch` in the Homey interview does **not** mean a door-contact device: the exact ZB003-X converter intentionally interprets IAS alarm1 as occupancy.

| Source | Exact `manufacturerName` / `modelId` | Observed endpoints |
| --- | --- | --- |
| This issue #1035 (BSEED LP-GL86ZTS41W) | `_TZ3000_s6ma1nh4 / TS0004` | EP1 0/3/4/5/6/E000/E001; EP2–4 4/5/6/E001 |
| Duplicate source #1368 (independent physical sample) | `_TZ3000_enmfaave / TS0004` | Same observed EP1/EP2/EP3/EP4 standard On/Off contract |

The dedicated Homey Compose profile **requires only the common standard On/Off core**, EP1 Basic0+Groups4+Scenes5+OnOff6, EP2/EP3/EP4 Groups4+Scenes5+OnOff6, with OnOff bindings on all four. It creates one parent and three subdevice Homey tiles. It does not require optional E000/E001 or perform vendor-specific writes. **Neither source interview advertises Simple Metering 0x0702 or Electrical Measurement 0x0B04**: no metering capabilities have been invented. The differently fingerprinted metering family #722 (`_TZ3000_ltt60asa / TS0004`) and TS0726 #1338 remain separate.

**Important runtime isolation:** The legacy `relay_board_4_channel` device.js registers correct EP1–4, but also issues an EP1 Basic-cluster read on **each** child initialization. To avoid that unnecessary traffic without changing already installed devices, the new dedicated `switch_4_gang_ts0004/device.js` uses the already supported Homey `ZigBeeDevice.registerCapability('onoff', CLUSTER.ON_OFF, { endpoint })` pattern only, with explicit subdevice → EP2/EP3/EP4 mapping, main → EP1, and fail-closed unknown subdevices. No Basic reads or vendor writes are made by this isolated runtime. The new driver.js simply reuses the existing default `ZigBeeDriver` from `relay_board_4_channel`, which contains no custom behavior.
